A hand-drawn 2D animation frame, anime illustration. Delicate drawn contours, stylized anime facial proportions, expressive drawn eyes, cel-painted skin and clothes with soft painted shading. The environment is a painted animation background.

A young woman with short bobbed black hair stands on a rural road. She wears an orange collared shirt with buttoned front, short sleeves, and green shorts with belt loops. A green backpack with straps is worn over her shoulders. She faces slightly right, looking toward viewer. Background shows winding road, grassy fields, distant hills, and blue sky with clouds. Lighting is bright, casting soft shadows on road and clothing.

anime drawing; soft, blended outlines around figure and background elements; smooth cel shading with gradient transitions on skin and clothing; vivid saturation with high contrast, warm orange and green tones under bright sky; smooth digital paint texture on skin and fabric, no visible brushstrokes or grain
